method: Original outer stage with all subsystem calls except the interface supplied as no-ops; interface uses the original dynamic-tree broadphase table 0x29ca8a0 so slot +0x98 (pair-record append and growth) and slot +0xa8 execute natively; allocator global slots authored. Model: publish_pending_links + append_broadphase_pair + reserve_pair_records + mark_broadphase_active on PoseFlatMemory
comparisons: every byte of owner (phase), context, pending span, links, broadphase object, new-pair vector header and record storage
coverage: vector capacity 0/1/2/4/16 with growth from zero (8) and doubling via realloc
active count zero and nonzero (+0x49 flag)
limits: Null pending entries are excluded: the stage passes null and 0x199b590 would dereference it.
Other subsystem calls are no-ops here (validated separately).
